summary: Independently verified the /rmaat-flyer route via Playwright. Both user-reported bugs (page-not-scrollable, primitive design) are FIXED. Page renders the redesigned premium flyer with all required sections, the QR code, the exact registration URL, and the PDF download works end-to-end (valid %PDF blob, 191,640 bytes, filename RMAAT_AX10_Flyer.pdf).
tests_executed: Page load: rmaat-flyer-page + rmaat-flyer visible (no console errors)
Hero: rmaat-hero-img and rmaat-logo visible, kicker 'ПОДЕЛИТЕСЬ ОПЫТОМ' present
Sections present: rmaat-time, rmaat-about, rmaat-features (3 cards), rmaat-cta, rmaat-audience (6 items), rmaat-qr
QR rendered as data:image/png;base64 dataURL inside CTA band

SCROLL BUG FIX: body/html/#root computed overflow = 'auto' (override applied); body.scrollHeight=1931, innerHeight=900; window.scrollTo(0, scrollHeight) -> scrollY=1031 (>50); footer slogan 'ВМЕСТЕ СОЗДАЁМ НОВЫЕ ТОЧКИ ПРИТЯЖЕНИЯ...' visible after scroll
PDF DOWNLOAD: clicked rmaat-pdf-btn, expect_download fired, filename=RMAAT_AX10_Flyer.pdf, size=191640 bytes, header bytes start with %PDF -> valid PDF; download completed without errors
critical_code_review_comments: RmaatFlyer.jsx overrides global overflow on html/body/#root in useEffect - works correctly and restores on unmount; acceptable workaround but the root cause is a global rule in App.css setting overflow:hidden on html/body/#root. Long-term it'd be cleaner to scope that rule to only the presentation routes that need it, instead of a global override that every standalone page must undo.
Page-level cleanup correctly restores prior overflow values on unmount - good.
All interactive/info elements have data-testid attributes - good test coverage.
context_for_next_testing_agent: RMAAT flyer at /rmaat-flyer is fully functional. Both reported bugs fixed and verified. PDF generation via @react-pdf/renderer works and produces a valid A4 PDF with QR + Cyrillic fonts (Montserrat/Manrope from jsDelivr). 0 console errors. No further action required.
rca of the issue: Scroll bug was caused by /app/frontend/src/App.css setting overflow:hidden on html, body and #root (intended for fixed-viewport presentation slides). The fix in RmaatFlyer.jsx useEffect overrides .style.overflow='auto' and .style.height='auto' on those three elements at mount and restores the prior values on unmount. Verified at runtime: computed overflow becomes 'auto' on all three, window.scrollY reaches 1031px on a 1931px document, footer becomes visible.
